business_scope.primary_industry_name: Die-Struck Brass Cloisonné Polishing of Novelty Enamel Badges

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law, French civil law, and customary law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No standalone bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement currently in force for Vanuatu
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) regional trade framework applies
Cotonou Agreement (EU–ACP partnership framework) applicable to Vanuatu as an ACP State

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Vanuatu International Companies Act [Cap 222] (ICA), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 17 of 2014 (introducing the beneficial owner register); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 33 of 2000, as amended; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the country of residence or nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed utility provider or regulated financial institution in the applicant's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or corporate extract for any corporate shareholder or UBO entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry in the entity's country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the applicant's home jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed UBOs, directors, officers, and commercial counterparties against the VFIU consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, and Vanuatu domestic advisories. Enhanced due diligence is required for any PEP or proximity-to-PEP relationship. Source of funds and wealth evidence is mandatory where any proposed UBO is a PEP or sanctioned-adjacent entity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Online Companies and International Companies Registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Proposed corporate names must be submitted in English or French, the official legal languages of Vanuatu. Non-Latin scripts are permissible only with a transliteration into Latin characters. Bislama names may be accepted where clearly distinct. The name must end with an appropriate corporate suffix for an International Company, typically 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', or 'Incorporated', as permitted under the ICA.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Ministerial approval required for any name implying state or regulatory sponsorship
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must file a written appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days, citing the statutory basis for admissibility and proposing an amended distinguishing element, if appropriate. If the Registrar rejects the appeal, the applicant may apply to the Vanuatu Supreme Court for judicial review within 30 days of the rejection notice. The appeal process does not suspend the name reservation window; a fresh reservation is required if the window lapses during appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible and standard for an International Company; VFSC requires a registered office and licensed registered agent in Vanuatu, but the physical business operations of an enamel lapel pin merchandising company may be conducted remotely from abroad. A virtual office arrangement at the registered agent's address is accepted for a low-risk, non-licensed merchandising entity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for this industry, estimated at 5–8% annual probability. VFSC or the registered agent may be subject to a compliance audit, but unannounced physical inspection of the taxpayer's actual production facility is not a statutory requirement absent a license or high-risk exposure. Desk-based AML/CFT file reviews are more likely than on-site premises visits.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], Republic of Vanuatu, as amended (IC Act); specifically Sections 2 (incorporation), 4 (capacity), 5 (registration), and 18 (registered office). Supplemental: Registered Agent Licensing Act [Cap. 222A].
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company, together with Form 1 – Application for Registration of an International Company (executed by the licensed Registered Agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no statutory escrow account required under the IC Act; a fully non-resident owned International Company may issue no-par shares from initial working capital of USD 1.00 or such sum as the first Director deems adequate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that (1) the founding subscriber's subscription for 10,000 ordinary no-par shares be and is hereby ratified and share certificates issued accordingly; (2) the registered office of the Company, located at the office of the licensed Registered Agent in Port Vila, Efate, Vanuatu, be and is hereby adopted as the statutory registered office; (3) [Director Name] be and is hereby appointed sole Director with plenary management powers; (4) [Secretary Name] be and is hereby appointed Corporate Secretary; (5) the Director be and is hereby authorized to open bank and merchant accounts, to register the Company with Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe, and to execute all ancillary documents; and (6) the Registered Agent be retained as statutory agent for service of process and all returns filed with the VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through a licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent for a proposed name containing 'Limited' and connoting the manufacturing of novelty enamel lapel pins. Confirm the name is not identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered company, protected trademark, or restricted statutory expression.
required_dossiers: Copy of proposed director's passport and proof of home address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file an administrative objection or resubmit with two alternative names; no formal appeal is available and a fresh reservation is processed within the same SLA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Vanuatu) under the Notaries Act [Cap. 66] in coordination with the licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole founding subscriber and first director execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association. All signature pages must be notarized, and the Registered Agent must countersign Form 1 confirming compliance with the IC Act. The registered office clause must show the exact Port Vila address of the agent.
required_dossiers: Notarized passport copies of subscriber and director
Proof of address (utility bill or bank statement, dated within 3 months)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry rejects execution formalities, re-execute the defective pages and re-notarize; the Registered Agent files a corrective lodgment within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Registration Application and Payment of Statutory Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC – International Companies Registry (online and physical lodgment windows)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent files the executed constitutional documents and Form 1 with the VFSC, together with the USD 300 registration fee (composite of incorporation and first-year annual fee). The application is submitted through the VFSC online portal or at the VFSC Registry counter in Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Consent to act of Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the Registered Agent files an amended statement within 5 business days addressing the query; if rejected, re-apply with corrected documents and pay only any incremental fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The Registered Agent then prepares the corporate kit comprising share certificates, minute book, company chop, and certified memorandum. The Company becomes a body corporate with full capacity as of the date on the Certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical errors, request a rectification certificate from the VFSC without re-filing; corrections issue within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Certificate and Municipal Business Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA); Port Vila City Council or Luganville Municipal Council under the Municipalities Act [Cap. 126]
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: As the manufacturing of hard-enamel lapel pins will involve a physical production site in Vanuatu, the Company must obtain a Foreign Investment Certificate from VIPA for the permitted activity 'Manufacture of imitation jewellery and novelty badges' (ISIC 3240). Thereafter, apply for an annual Business Licence from the relevant Municipal Council authorizing industrial/manufacturing premises.
required_dossiers: Business licence application with premises lease agreement
Site plan and production process description
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VIPA imposes conditions, submit a written compliance plan and amend the production/export description; if the Municipal Council queries the premises zoning, provide a structural assessment and zoning confirmation from the Department of Physical Planning.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) in coordination with the Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce; municipal business licensing administered by the Port Vila City Council
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturing Establishment Business Licence and Foreign Investment Certificate (Activity: ISIC 3240 – Manufacture of Imitation Jewellery, Novelty Enamel Badges and Cloisonné Lapel Pins)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management – under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [Cap. 283]
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (Category 2 – Low Impact Specified Activity): required under Schedule 2 of the Environmental Management (EIA) Regulations for small-scale metal polishing, enameling and kiln-firing operations; a full EIA Report is not mandated for premises with annual production below 500,000 units and wastewater discharge below 20 m3 per day.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: pH 6.5–8.5; total suspended solids not exceeding 50 mg/L; biochemical oxygen demand (BOD5) not exceeding 30 mg/L; total recoverable heavy metals (copper, lead, zinc, nickel, chromium) remaining below Vanuatu National Water Quality Guideline values for inland discharge. Process ventilation: airborne particulates and volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions from enamel-curing ovens must not exceed 50 mg/m3 at stack discharge. Hazardous waste: spent alkaline cleaning baths, brass dust and enamel residue must be containerized and removed by a DEPC-registered waste carrier under the Waste Management Regulations 2020.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Service under the Fire Services Act [Cap. 127], covering kiln and oven fire suppression; structural load inspection and building permit clearance from the Department of Physical Planning for industrial floor loading of polishing machinery and kilns; and workplace registration with the Department of Labour under the Health and Safety at Work Act 2022, including an occupational health clearance for noise exposure (85 dBA threshold), chemical handling (enamel solvents and metal flux) and personal protective equipment protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for entity registration and licensing; Vanuatu Customs Service, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, for customs/trade filings. Official portals: https://www.vfsc.vu and https://www.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu does not issue a statutory corporate income-tax TIN or VAT ID because no income tax or VAT/GST regime exists. A Vanuatu International Company is identified by its VFSC registration number. For customs/export purposes, the exporter may obtain a customs client code from the Vanuatu Customs Service by submitting the certificate of incorporation, registered-agent particulars, and authorized signatory list.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, entity-classification election, or hybrid mismatch election is available under Vanuatu law. International Companies are statutorily tax-exempt; no fiscal election or hybrid mismatch elective regime exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/sales and use tax system exists in Vanuatu; indirect taxation is limited to customs duties on imports and certain stamp/business license fees.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST statute or registration threshold is expressed in Vanuatu Vatu (VUV). Customs registration may be required for repeat exporters.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandate. Vanuatu does not operate an electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — no VAT/GST exists, therefore there is no export zero-rating rate or export VAT refund mechanism. Physical exports of hard enamel lapel pins are generally outside any domestic indirect tax net; customs duty treatment applies only to imports, not exports.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating scheme exists, so no VAT clawback can arise. Customs false-export declarations and smuggling alike are subject to penalties, fines, forfeiture, and civil recovery under the Vanuatu Customs Act. Misuse or misrepresentation of the International Company's tax-exempt status is separately subject to VFSC regulatory enforcement and potential deregistration.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) – central bank and exchange control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 45] and the Financial Dealers Act [Cap. 70], administered through authorized banks and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for licensed entities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible for current international transactions, including trade in goods, services, and profit repatriation, provided transactions are settled through an authorized dealer with the required exchange control forms. Capital account inflows and outflows, including equity injections and loan repayments by residents, require Exchange Control consent; however, an International Company (IC) is treated as an offshore non-resident enterprise for exchange control purposes and may maintain foreign currency accounts with authorized dealers without repatriation or conversion obligations on foreign-source income. Profit remittance is unobstructed because Vanuatu imposes no income tax, no dividend withholding tax, and no capital gains tax on ICs. Practical hurdles relate to the small correspondent banking footprint, the need for manual exchange control declarations on inward and outward settlements, and the absence of a deep local interbank FX market. ICs should use an authorized dealer for all VUV conversions and maintain documentation proving the offshore character of the transactions to avoid recharacterization as domestic activity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act and RBV Exchange Control Notices, all proceeds from exports of goods from Vanuatu must, unless an exemption is granted, be repatriated to an authorized dealer in Vanuatu within 180 days of the date of export, and the VUV equivalent must be surrendered if the proceeds are denominated in a foreign currency. In practice, an International Company engaged in cross-border trade may apply for a standing exemption from the surrender and conversion requirement by applying to the RBV through its nominated authorized bank, supported by a letter describing the offshore export business model, the use of an offshore foreign currency settlement account, and the absence of VUV obligations. The applicable statutory export documents are the Customs export declaration lodged in ASYCUDA World, the commercial invoice, packing list, and Bill of Lading/Air Waybill confirming shipment of the finished enamel pins. Failure to remit within the prescribed timeline triggers exchange control penalties and, for banks, AML red flags; therefore the treasury procedure must include automated compliance monitoring of all outside (receivable) collections within the 180-day lookback window.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific Vanuatu Limited (BSP Vanuatu)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (Foreign Currency and VUV Settlement)
Operational Account (Foreign Currency and VUV Settlement)
Operational Account (Foreign Currency and VUV Settlement)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility is Low-Medium. Vanuatu has no licensed Electronic Money Institution (EMI) sector under RBV laws, and offshore EMI platforms registered in Europe, Asia, or the UK generally do not offer onboarding to Vanuatu-domiciled International Companies unless the entity can demonstrate a substantive non-specified reason for an offshore structure and pass the platform's enhanced due diligence. The VFSC does not issue EMI licenses to foreign fintechs for operation into Vanuatu, so a purely digital EMI account cannot serve as the sole banking rail. Such platforms may be acceptable as a supplementary payment collection route for low-value Etsy/Stripe receivables, but all settlement liquidity must eventually be passed through an anchored VUV-FX or USD settlement account at an RBV-authorized bank. Legal constraint: use of an unregulated overseas EMI in lieu of a licensed domestic financial institution could expose the treasury to Vanuatu International Companies Act restrictions on retention of foreign currency proceeds, and to correspondent banking de-risking concerns.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally not mandated by RBV for International Companies, but the onboarding bank reserves discretion to require a face-to-face interview for the 25% or more beneficial owner if existing KYC profiling flags uncertainty. All three high-tier banks in practice allow fully remote account opening for an IC provided the corporate registry agent of VFSC submits certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation, the Register of Members, the Register of Directors, the IC's registered agent consent letter, the ID and proof of address of all directors and shareholders above 10% beneficial ownership, and a notarized board resolution approving the account opening. A minimum of one executive director may be required to participate in a video conference call with the bank's compliance officer. For a non-resident IC with no physical substance in Vanuatu, the bank will commonly impose a substance questionnaire, an expectation that the IC remain registered in good standing with VFSC, and a prohibition on transacting with Vanuatu residents or receiving domestic income.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-exempt International Company without substantive local economic activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approved VFSC IC certificate, registered agent engagement letter, board minutes confirming the offshore export business model, audited or management accounts showing separate third-party suppliers, manufacturer contracts for enamel pins, and a substance narrative explaining that Vanuatu was chosen solely for tax-neutrality, legal stability, and trade cost efficiency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Disproportionate cross-border trade flows with mismatched shipment evidence or low-commodity-value, high-volume invoicing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Clean commercial invoices tied to purchase orders, warehouse/shipping confirmations, HS Code 7326 or 7117 declarations, customs AWB/BOL records, bank statements of historical clears, and any third-party inspection certificates (e.g., SGS/Intertek) for the die-struck brass and enamel work.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership or nominee director/shareholder structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete chart of the 10%+ ultimate beneficial owners, copies of passports and utility bills, no bearer shares in issue (IC Act prohibition), statutory registers, and notarized declarations of trust or family wealth in cases of fiduciary holding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk source of funds routed from an unregulated online marketplace (Etsy/Stripe) with non-transparent ultimate buyers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export payment processing agreements with Stripe/Etsy Payment, consumer-clearing evidence, reconciliation spreadsheets, refund and chargeback policies, transaction-level payout reports, and a documented Anti-Money Laundering due diligence policy for marketplace sales in the IC's treasury manual.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Currency and jurisdiction mismatch where IC bills abroad but supplier payments are made through a third-party clearing jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed trade flow mapping showing the manufacturing principal, shipping corridor, settlement bank, and payment intermediary; supplier contracts with metal/enamel material vendors; and legal opinions on the non-resident character of the IC under Vanuatu exchange control.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity or working capital injections from shareholders or affiliated holding companies must be routed through an authorized dealer in Vanuatu using SWIFT MT103 with a proper Remittance Information field. The correct balance of payments purpose code for inward direct investment into an offshore IC is 'DIR' (Direct Investment Other Capital) or 'FNO' (Financial Non-Operating/Intercompany) as mapped by the RBV operational manual, with the narrative reflecting 'Contribution to working capital of non-resident International Company' to prevent misclassification as domestic settlement. The receiving bank will require a board resolution from the injecting entity, source-of-funds evidence (declared dividend reserve, audited profit, or loan agreement if the injection is a shareholder loan), and a completed RBV Exchange Control Form ECOM-1 if the transfer does not automatically qualify under the IC's standing exemption. For the substrate of the enamel pins, if the IC receives a capital injection from a related Hangzhou or Shenzhen entity, the bank should be provided with the intercompany loan note, evidence of market-rate interest, and confirmation that no inferential Vanuatu income is being created.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for raw material imports (brass blanks, cloisonné wire, enamel powders, polished plating chemicals) and logistics costs must be cleared through the bank's trade finance rails. For low-value repetitive payments, use SWIFT MT103 'C' priority with purpose code 'ITR' (Imports of Goods) or 'SRV' (Services) and full underlying invoice, packing list, and transport documents. For major consignments above the bank's USD 25,000 threshold, use a documentary irrevocable Letter of Credit (L/C) issued by the Vanuatu bank by MT700 with 90-120 days usance against full set of clean on board bills of lading, commercial invoice, and certificate of origin. The clearing house trail is routed via the US dollar correspondent account of the Vanuatu bank (typically at Barclays London, Bank of America New York, or HSBC Hong Kong) before on-settlement to beneficiaries in China, EU, or the UK. Any VUV conversion required for domestic payments is executed at prevailing interbank rates with a 24-hour forward booking option to cap FX friction. Settlement timing discipline requires an SHIFT (start-of-day float calendar) and a daily real-time liquidity dashboard to ensure that exposure to the offshore settlement accounts never exceeds 120% of the next week's payables.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu Vatu / US Dollar deliverable forward contracts (tenor up to 12 months) entered into with an authorized dealer bank and recorded under a master ISDA/ISBDA agreement
Vanuatu Vatu / Australian Dollar deliverable forward contracts for trade settlement with regional suppliers when required

US Dollar / Chinese Yuan cross-currency swap arranged onshore by the Vanuatu bank's Hong Kong correspondent desk to hedge CNY-denominated material purchases, subject to the Vanuatu bank's internal credit and counter-party risk limits
Short-dated options on USD/VUV traded through the authorized dealer only if the IC's board has approved a hedge accounting framework and is not using the option for speculative gain

Non-deliverable forwards are not permissible for the VUV in the offshore market because the RBV does not publish a benchmark fix and the currency is not freely deliverable offshore; any NDF trade must be permitted as a synthetic hedge under an express RBV waiver in support of the trade's genuine underlying exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee and Registered Agent Renewal Certificate for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Section
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation; VFSC renewal is set to the incorporation anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs escalating penalties of 10% of the annual fee for the first 90 days and up to 25% thereafter; continued non-payment beyond 9 months triggers administrative strike-off, restoration fees, and legal clearance requirements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry via the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be lodged concurrently with the annual renewal payment on each incorporation anniversary.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a current registered office or agent may invalidate service of process, attract a penalty of up to VUV 50,000, and persistent default may result in administrative strike-off by VFSC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Register of Members and Register of Directors Annual Updating
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company registered office as custodian; subject to VFSC inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous obligation; any share transfer or director change must be recorded within 15 business days, with a full annual verification by the registered agent on the anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with the International Companies Act register requirements is a statutory offense; on conviction directors may be fined VUV 50,000, and willful default may lead to VFSC strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit is imposed on a Vanuatu International Company solely by statute. A compulsory audit is triggered only if VFSC imposes an audit condition on a licensed activity, if the company undertakes a public offering, or if shareholders holding the required percentage in the articles requisition an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted internationally; Vanuatu Law does not require the filing of financial statements with VFSC for standard International Companies, but accounting records must be sufficient to disclose and explain transactions and the financial position.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must, on each incorporation anniversary, confirm with the directors that all share transfers completed during the year have been recorded in the register of members and that the ultimate beneficial ownership details held at the registered office remain accurate and complete. No separate public UBO filing is required, but the agent must maintain the updated schedule and support any lawful inspection request.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a Vanuatu International Company (IC) validly certified as non-resident under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018. A domestic/resident company carrying on business in Vanuatu is taxable at 25% on assessable income exceeding VT 4 million per annum under the Income Tax Act [Cap 231].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: National zero-tax framework: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, no inheritance or gift tax, and no withholding taxes on dividends, interest, or royalties. Exported goods (including enamel lapel pins sold via Etsy or Stripe to foreign buyers) are zero-rated for VAT under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap 279]. An IC holding a Certificate of Non-Residence is outside the Vanuatu income tax net entirely.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Statement of Compliance (IC-ASC) filed via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Registry portal (www.vfsc.vu).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 20 days after the anniversary date of incorporation each year. Annual VFSC government fee (currently USD 300) is payable within 30 days of the same anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered IC name, VFSC registration number, date of incorporation, and registered office address in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the Certificate of Non-Residence number and issue date; this confirms the IC is outside Vanuatu's income tax and is required for the zero-tax treatment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationality, residential address, and passport details of each director and shareholder; share capital structure and classes of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All non-resident individuals and corporate shareholders must be disclosed to the registered agent; nominee shareholding is permitted but the ultimate beneficial owner must be recorded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company has not carried on business within Vanuatu, has not owned land in Vanuatu, and has not engaged in banking, trust, or insurance business with Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any false declaration nullifies the non-resident certificate and subjects the IC to domestic 25% corporate tax and licensing penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the licensed registered agent that statutory records (register of directors, shareholders, mortgages, charges, and minutes) are maintained at the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Records must be retained for at least seven years; failure to maintain records converts the IC into a non-compliant entity subject to deregistration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual fee: 10% of the annual fee per month or part-month, capped at 100% of the fee. Failure to file the Annual Statement of Compliance or pay the fee for three consecutive years results in strike-off/deregistration by the VFSC Registrar, loss of limited liability, and the restoration surcharge of VT 10,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (Form VDP) filed electronically through the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) taxpayer portal. Mandatory only if the IC is registered for VAT (mandatory once taxable annual turnover exceeds VT 5 million).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly (mandatory) or Quarterly (optional low-volume filer upon DCIR approval)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the month following the end of the VAT period; e.g., the January VAT return is due by the last day of February.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of taxable supplies and output VAT at 12.5% (or zero-rated export supplies to foreign buyers).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sales of enamel lapel pins shipped to customers outside Vanuatu are zero-rated exports; documentary proof (Bills of Lading, courier receipts, Etsy shipping records) must be retained to support the zero rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recoverable VAT paid on local purchases and on imported raw materials (base metals, enamel paints, brass) used in the manufacturing/export business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Import VAT paid at customs may be reclaimed only where the IC is VAT-registered and the goods are used for taxable exported supplies. Claim only with valid tax invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Difference between output VAT and deductible input VAT; export-only businesses will typically file nil or refund-input returns.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Filing a deliberately inflated refund claim constitutes tax fraud and triggers a 100% penalty plus criminal prosecution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or late payment: penalty of 10% of the VAT due plus interest at 2% per month on the outstanding amount. Knowingly false returns: penalty of double the tax evaded and, on conviction, a fine not exceeding VT 5 million or imprisonment for up to five years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% – Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends, whether paid to resident or non-resident shareholders. An IC may distribute all after-tax (i.e., untaxed) profits to its shareholders with no deduction at source.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No double-taxation agreements (DTAs) are in force for Vanuatu. There is no tax treaty network and no domestic TRC (Tax Residency Certificate) procedure. The operative evidence of tax status is the Certificate of Non-Residence issued by the VFSC under section 5 of the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018. Foreign shareholders should present this certificate, together with the VFSC Certificate of Good Standing, to their home tax authorities to support an exemption or foreign-tax-credit position; no Vanuatu administrative relief application is required because no Vanuatu tax is imposed.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for both interest and intellectual-property royalties paid by an IC to non-residents. Treaty rate: not applicable (no DTA in force). Payments to related foreign parties must still be priced on commercially realistic terms to avoid audit challenge in the recipient's jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer-pricing documentation threshold (Local File or Master File) exists under Vanuatu law; the DCIR has not issued TP regulations. An IC must nonetheless maintain proper books of account and underlying transaction records for seven years at its registered office to substantiate the arm's-length nature of cross-border payments to related parties if a foreign tax authority initiates an audit or a CFC inquiry.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) applicable to International Companies. An IC certified as non-resident is excluded from local substance requirements. However, the IC's ultimate shareholders, if tax-resident in an OECD/EU jurisdiction, will be subject to the foreign jurisdiction's CFC, GAAR, and economic-substance rules; a shell IC without genuine business substance (real management, real manufacturing contracts, and real cash flows) is exposed to recharacterisation, back-taxes, and penalties in the shareholder's home country. Within Vanuatu, the IC must not engage in banking, trust, insurance, or land-owning activity with Vanuatu residents or it forfeits its non-resident status.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely declaring in the VFSC Annual Statement of Compliance that the IC is non-resident while knowingly carrying on a Vanuatu-sourced business; understating export revenue; submitting a knowingly inflated VAT refund claim; or using the IC to conceal taxable profits from another jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of non-resident certificate; reclassification as a resident company liable to 25% corporate tax on Vanuatu-source income; VAT fraud penalty of 100% of the tax evaded plus interest at 2% per month; criminal conviction for income tax/VAT offences carrying fines up to VT 5 million and/or imprisonment for up to five years; deregistration and strike-off by VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for fines and imprisonment for tax offences (Income Tax Act s.139, VAT Act); VFSC may disqualify directors for three years; a director who authorises false filings is jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid taxes and penalties where the company is struck off or insolvent.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a pure brass-plate shell with no commercial reality (no manufacturing activity, no bank account, no staff, no records) in order to claim zero tax in Vanuatu while the effective business (Etsy sales of enamel pins) is managed from a high-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu law: no direct ESR penalty, but VFSC may refuse the Certificate of Non-Residence and deregister the company. Under foreign law: CFC/GAAR recharacterisation of 100% of the IC's profits as taxable in the shareholder's residence; penalties for failure to file CFC disclosures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors/shareholders are exposed to personal assessment for the foreign tax under CFC attribution rules; travel bans and asset freezes can be imposed in the shareholder's home jurisdiction for deliberate tax evasion; a director's personal bank accounts may be examined under mutual-assistance procedures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to disclose ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) to the licensed registered agent or VFSC; using bearer shares (prohibited); laundering funds through Etsy/Stripe payment rails in the IC's name; failing to keep a register of directors and shareholders at the registered office.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018 and the AML/CFT (Amendment) Regulation 2021 (post-FATF): administrative penalties of up to VT 1 million for record-keeping failures; deregistration for failure to provide UBO information; the IC's bank accounts may be frozen upon VFSC notification to financial institutions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Director and registered agent are personally liable to fines up to VT 1 million; directors of a money-laundering entity face a custodial sentence of up to 15 years under the Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap 270]; travel bans are routinely sought in extradition requests for financial crime.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC sells enamel lapel pins to customers physically located in Vanuatu (domestic retail sales) at any time without obtaining a Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 241] and without VAT registration once the VT 5 million threshold is crossed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Ministerial fine of VT 50,000 for trading without a licence; court-imposed additional fine of VT 10,000 per month of continued unlicensed trading; the VFSC will revoke the Certificate of Non-Residence; the IC becomes subject to 25% corporate income tax and VAT at 12.5% on all Vanuatu domestic sales.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly trade without a licence are personally liable for the fines and any unpaid corporate tax; the VFSC Registrar may bar the director from acting as a director of any Vanuatu company for up to five years; personal bankruptcy proceedings may follow if the company is deregistered with outstanding liabilities.
